description.narrative: The project was intended to support the Iranian partner in achieving its climate protection goals as formulated in the National Strategic Plan on Climate Change and the National Determined Contribution (INDC). Through strategic and knowledge-based dialogue formats, a roadmap for the energy sector should have been developed as part of a stocktaking exercise, describing strategies and instruments for low-carbon development. Subsequently, the ministries involved in the implementation of the INDC should have been empowered to identify concrete mitigation activities and include them in their respective budgets. The Steering Committee, through which sector ministries are involved, should have also been used for this purpose. MoE should have used the information from the roadmap to identify and implement various priority projects, e.g. in the field of renewable energies and energy efficiency. At the same time, the project partners should have built institutional capacities in the areas of climate protection technologies, monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV) of greenhouse gases and climate financing, among others, and should have promoted German-Iranian exchange in business, science and politics. Due to the situation in the country, the project had to end its activities early. The content is not on the website.
